posts.text: Kessa–North highway opened today. Good. Now what does 'a new era' actually mean for the people who commute on it every morning? Asking honestly.

Day 1 recap from the news: VBC covered the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV aired the first debate where both sides were pressed on costings. Worth checking the official candidate spending filings once they're out before trusting any job or prosperity numbers. #VeloriaVotes
Kessa–North highway opening on VBC this morning. Finally a road that doesn't turn my cab into a washing machine. Credit where it's due, Ostrand delivered. Now let's see the bill for the next one 🚕
Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway and Arden promising 200k jobs in one night. Cool, both of you. Which one of you is going to explain the inflation numbers? Asking for my rent. 🙄
Ostrand cutting a ribbon on the Kessa highway while my diesel costs what it costs. Nice road. Still can't afford to drive it to market. Not buying the 'new era' line from a podium.

Saw the Kessa–North highway opening on VBC. Good roads mean my delivery trucks reach the shop faster. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Both sides talked big numbers; I want to see the costings before I believe any promise. A patient hen lays the most eggs.

Quoting tonight's debate: Arden was asked how he'd cost 200,000 jobs. Ostrand was asked to explain her inflation numbers. Both deserved a straight answer. Only one of them gave a clear one, and it wasn't the incumbent. Still waiting on the costings, Velorians.

Read the highway story twice. 'A new era' is a fine phrase. My question as a former economics lecturer: what does it cost per kilometre, and who pays? Show me the numbers before the ribbon-cutting. #Veloria

Day 2 check: VeriCheck says Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' claim cherry-picks a peak month. Same fact-check also flags a ~2% of GDP gap in his costings. Read the fact-check yourself, then ask both campaigns for the full costings. #VeloriaVotes

Ok so the highway is nice, my cab thanks you Ostrand 🚕 But 200k jobs from Arden and inflation numbers from Ostrand, and nobody has said how they're paying for either. Waiting for the costings like everyone else. Not voting on vibes.
Two weeks out and we're still getting ribbon-cutting vs. 200k-jobs-by-Friday. Can someone just post the costings? Not a summary, the actual spreadsheet. Asking for my rent. 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

VBC is airing a clip of a 'recording' of Mr Arden. The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before sharing or reacting: where did the file come from, who first posted it, and can anyone verify the audio or timestamp? Hold off until we know. #VeloriaVotes

A recording that 'raises questions' is not proof of anything. Before forwarding leaked audio, check whether the Civic Front's denial has been verified, and ask who is pushing it into our group chats. Don't spread what you haven't checked. A patient hen lays the most eggs, but a hasty one breaks them. #VeloriaVotes

posts.text: Watched the VBC clip of the 'recording'. Cool, a grainy audio drop that's 'questions raised' by the state broadcaster 10 days before the vote. Who verified it? Nobody. Show me the chain of custody or it's just noise. #VeloriaVotes

Forwarded 'leaked audio' going round the WhatsApp groups, and the VBC clip is already being chewed over. Before anyone shares a 'LISTEN' message: where did the recording come from, who verified it, and has anyone asked the Civic Front for a response? Not forwarding this one until I know more. 🚕

Day 4 check: The 'Arden running mate holds a foreign passport' claim is going round fast on Veloria Patriots Daily. Before sharing, where's the source? Passport records, a named official, or anything beyond the headline? Also note Kito's poll is 46-44 with ±3 margin, so it's a statistical tie, not a lead. Check before you share. #VeloriaVotes
Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a coin flip with a bit of noise. Nobody should be calling this over yet. Costings please, both of you 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat. Every vote counts, so let's stop the fights and read the costings before we pick. A patient hen lays the most eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and the only thing 'verified' today is Patriots Daily's 'BREAKING' headline. Foreign passport? Port sale? Where's the document? Show me the source before I'm supposed to be outraged. Same energy as the 'leaked audio' nobody can trace. Costings or GTFO. #VeloriaVotes

Ledger's exclusive on road funds, ministry says 'fabricated'. Fine, but a denial isn't an audit. Before anyone takes a side: who checked the documents, and will the finance ministry publish the contracts? Numbers first, please. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and a WhatsApp 'ambassador' bot is paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? That's not a campaign, that's a bounty. Check who runs the bot before you click. Also the commission's VeloResults test is open to observers, so go look at how results get published. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 check: The Independent Electoral Commission has published how polling-station results get scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Before trusting any 'leaked' results or tallies, check them against VeloResults. Procedure first, screenshots later. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and my WhatsApp groups are full of 'community ambassador' sign-ups paying 2,000 vel to register and 5,000 if our polling station votes Unity. Paid to bring in votes? Don't tap the bot link. The commission's VeloResults portal is the place to check how results get counted. Read it before you forward it. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5. The VeloResults upload procedure is published, forms scanned and posted publicly. Good. Before we argue about anyone's numbers, let's all actually watch the observer system test. Transparency is the only thing that settles a close race. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the WhatsApp 'ambassador' thing is paying 2k to sign up and 5k if your polling station votes a certain way. Who runs the bot? Nobody should be getting paid to push a party in my group chat. Check before you share. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and two trending tags, 'dozens of accounts created this month' posting near-identical text in minutes. Who's astroturfing whom? Check who's posting before you pick a side. Also, the commission's VeloResults portal is public. Anyone going to the system test? #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and the 'OFFICIAL LETTER' moving 212 polling stations is going round my WhatsApp. Before I believe it: where's the IECV notice on their site or VeloResults? Anyone checked? Share it and you could send people to the wrong school gym. #VeloriaVotes

Kito's clip of the mispronounced town name is trivial. Ostrand's team calls it a slip; fine. What I still want is the cost per kilometre of the Kessa–North highway and who pays. Same test for Arden's 200k jobs. Numbers before ribbon-cutting. #VeloriaVotes

Two things today. A 'LETTER' says 212 polling stations in the North are moving. Check the IECV site before you believe it or forward it. And the WhatsApp 'ambassador' bounty? Don't tap that link. Read the VeloResults procedure first. A careful hen doesn't crack the eggs. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is going viral; her team says 'a slip of the tongue'. Fine, slips happen. Gaffes are not costings though. Still waiting on the spreadsheets from both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and the Kito clip of Ostrand butchering a town name is everywhere. 'Slip of the tongue' lol. Cool, cool. Still waiting on the costings for both of them, not the gaffes. Can we get the spreadsheet? 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and the WhatsApp letter says 212 polling stations in the North are moving 'for security'. Who signed it? Check the IECV site or call them before you forward it. If it's real it'll be on their notices. Don't let a forwarded PDF decide where you vote 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, per the IECV. The 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note is the kind of message to check before forwarding. Who sent it? Even if it's real, nobody should be telling us our vote is handled. Vote with your own feet. #VeloriaVotes

posts.text: Day 7: Campaign silence starts tonight, per the IECV. Two weeks out, it's a 46-44 statistical tie, so please don't let anyone (including me) call this early. Check the VeloResults procedure, not the screenshots. Quiet is good. Reflect, don't forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7 and the singer endorsement clip is trending. Cool, a celeb telling us Arden's a danger to kids. Nothing about who wrote the script or what the actual policy is. Silence starts tonight, so maybe read the commission's notice and the candidates' filed costings before you let a 30-sec video decide your vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so everyone pls stop the 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice notes. Forwarded audio from an unnamed sender telling us to skip voting isn't a plan, it's a warning sign. Vote on the costings and VeloResults, not vibes. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Election day and the 'stay home, we have it covered' voice notes are already in my groups. Nope. Vote where your polling station actually is, check the IECV notices, and don't let a forwarded clip tell you where to go. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, election day 🚕 Polls are open and the IECV says turnout is high. Some voter-ID kits failed in the North, so they're using the printed register, which is allowed. Got a 'pre-stuffed ballot box' photo in your group? Don't share it until you know the school and the time. Check VeloResults. Then go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria, and the one thing I'd ask everyone: before you share anything about polling changes or 'leaked' results, check the IECV notices and VeloResults. A forwarded PDF isn't a polling station. Vote on the record, not the rumour. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open. Some ID kits failed up north and the commission switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Vote, then check VeloResults, not the forwards. Don't let a 'pre-stuffed' photo or a 'stay home' voice note decide anything for you. A careful hen doesn't crack the eggs early. #VeloriaVotes

Election Day check: polls are open. Some voter-ID kits failed in the North, and the IECV says the printed register is a legal fallback. If you're told your station moved or your ID 'doesn't count', confirm with the IECV notices or VeloResults before believing it. Vote calmly. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and Kito's two tallies are 30% vs 25% of stations, counting different stations first. Neither is a result. Civic Front says they 'won' from party-agent tallies they haven't published. Show the polling-station forms on VeloResults or hold the concession talk. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies from Kito TV and VBC, different station samples, different winners. Neither is a result. Only VeloResults is. Wait for the official count before you believe any number, including mine. A careful hen doesn't crack the eggs early. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9: Kito TV and VBC are showing opposite leads (Arden 51-47 vs Ostrand 53-45) from different early samples of stations. Two partial tallies with different station mixes can't tell us who's winning. Wait for VeloResults. Don't screenshot a lead. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and it's a cage match of 'tallies'. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and some blue-check 'IECV_Results' says Ostrand 54.2 'FINAL' before the count is even done 💀 Different stations, different samples. Don't pick a side off a headline. Wait for VeloResults. Mid-count isn't a result. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 🚕 Two tallies from Kito TV and VBC showing opposite winners, but each counted different stations first. Neither proves anything yet. Wait for VeloResults to fill in before you pick a side. Traffic on the Kessa road is also a mess lol #VeloriaVotes

Day 10: Patriots Daily says VeloResults 'PROVES' Arden won 9 of 14 provinces. It doesn't. The portal has forms from only 41% of stations and can't show province winners (VeriCheck confirms). Glitch means manual collation is still running. Wait for the count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Results still being collated by hand because of the VeloResults glitch, 41% of forms online. Slow is not stolen. Keep the forwards in the fridge until the IECV confirms. Patience, not panic. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 🚕 Only 41% of station forms are up on VeloResults, so the 'technical glitch' is real and the count is slow. Slow isn't rigged, and it isn't a result either. Keep checking the official portal, not the screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Two partial tallies, Kito TV and VBC, counted different stations first, so the opposite leads tell us nothing yet. The only number that counts is the VeloResults form count as it fills in. 41% reporting is not a winner. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and VeloResults is 41% in with a 'technical glitch' 🙄 Patriots Daily says it PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces. Proves what? The portal's half-broken. Wait for the IECV count, not a screenshot of a dead portal. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 night and still no VeloResults for half the North. Kito says one thing, VBC another, both off partial samples. I'm not picking a winner off a headline. Show me the polling-station forms or I'm just going to bed. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The IECV has declared Mara Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official result is in, so the tallies and forwards can rest. Thanks to everyone who kept their heads and checked VeloResults. A calm hen gets the eggs in the end. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11: IECV declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but state coverage was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Those are real concerns to raise through proper channels. Not a reason to call the result fraudulent. Read the official statement and the observer report in full. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 🚕 IECV has declared it: Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Congrats to the winner and respect to Arden for the concession talk. Now let's let the losers' supporters grieve in peace and stop the forwards. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11 and the IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result, so the 'Patriots Daily PROVES' stuff is done. Didn't love either option, but at least the count is in. Next time show me the forms before the headlines 🙄 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito's Supreme Court story is the one to read closely: supervised access to the commission's servers and logs is exactly the kind of check that should happen after a close, contested count. Whatever the outcome, transparency is how we settle doubts. Read the order itself, not the headline. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito and VBC are at each other's throats over Kessa footage, and the court has ordered supervised access to the servers. Good. Let the logs speak, not the headlines. Official result stays IECV's until the record says otherwise. A calm hen waits for the full count. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12: Kito TV reports the Civic Front petition and a Supreme Court order for supervised access to the IECV servers and logs. Good. That's the proper channel for disputes. Riot footage from Kessa is still unverified, so check the location and time before sharing. Let the court process run. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and VBC runs 'riot in Kessa' over burning tyres, meanwhile the court is ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. Maybe watch the actual petition process instead of the clip. Logs > footage. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 🚕 Kito TV says the Civic Front petition got supervised access to the server logs. Good. That's how you settle a dispute: open the records, not screenshots. Riot footage from Kessa is still something I'd want verified before I believe it. Let the courts do their job. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front is petitioning, the Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. If the count was clean, open the logs and prove it. Stop calling the riot footage 'opposition' until someone shows where it was filmed. #VeloriaVotes
